title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to launch our new public roadmap, giving you a transparent look at our past accomplishments and exciting future plans for Noeko.

title: Smarter, More Intuitive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy significantly easier-to-use checkboxes that are larger, more visually appealing, and effortlessly draggable, making your task management smoother.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded our real-time collaboration features to make working with your team smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Enhanced File & Image Management
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your content with a new, intuitive file management system that allows you to easily upload, link, organize, and customize how images and files appear directly in your editor.

title: Advanced Search & Curated Collections
summary: Transform your search experience with powerful new filtering, sorting, and collection features designed to help you quickly pinpoint and curate your most valuable insights.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Transform your note-taking experience with flexible new layouts that make linked content more interactive and intuitive, perfectly reflecting your thought process.

title: Noeko's Public Launch and Flexible Hosting Options
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official public release of Noeko, empowering users with versatile self-hosting capabilities and introducing premium plans tailored to diverse needs.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Stunning New Themes
summary: We are dramatically expanding and refining our theme collection to offer a beautiful, diverse, and visually consistent experience that empowers you to personalize your workspace.
